correctness.independent_verification: Recomputed the 3×3 mass-weighted matrices and eigenspectral projectors for five independently selected mass/coupling examples, and symbolically differentiated the R=3 cubic to check 64/81. Inspected the source check_p3.py but did not treat its asserted 2,100 randomized outcomes as our own independent execution. Kronecker density supplies the general irrational assertion.
correctness.rationale: The mass-normalized Jacobi Laplacian H has eigenvalues 0 and λ±=(S±sqrt(S²−4P))/2, distinct and positive for strictly positive masses/couplings. Spectral projector entries c0,c−,c+ follow from H_31=0 and (H²)_31=B, with c−<0<c0,c+. Their cosine combination A(t) attains absolute envelope C=2|c−| only at cos(ω−t)=−1, cos(ω+t)=1; the alternative negative extreme is strictly smaller since c0>0. Orthogonal eigenvector equality gives C≤1 with C=1 exactly for equal endpoint masses and couplings. Irrational frequency ratio R gives a nonattained supremum C² by torus density; rational coprime R=p/q parameterizes one periodic Chebyshev polynomial c0+c−T_q(x)+c+T_p(x), with equality to C only for p even, q odd. The prescribed critical points/endpoints give an exact compact maximization. In particular symmetric masses 24,6,24 with equal couplings yield R=3, amplitude 4/9−2x/3+2x³/9, max square 64/81.

value.rationale: For the physically derived three-site mass-weighted wave system, the best achievable endpoint fidelity is an intrinsic design invariant. An explicit all-parameter ceiling quantifies unavoidable losses from asymmetric mass/coupling; rational spectral locking either attains or strictly suppresses it, with a finite exact polynomial recipe and a concrete gap 17/81. The result provides a meaningful classification beyond known yes/no symmetric perfect transfer; it does not overclaim fixed-coupling discrete Grover transfer.
